title: Pulmonary Physiotherapy for Ischemic Stroke
brief_summary: This study evaluates the predictors of intensive care unit admission and mortality among stroke patients and the effects of pulmonary physiotherapy on these stroke patients. One-hundred patients participated in the pulmonary rehabilitation program and 81 patients served as a control group.
study_population: Patients who were admitted to the neurology clinic stroke unit or the neurological intensive care unit
